scope: Every real spacelike normal whose hyperplane crosses transversely an open edge incident to either displayed all-right finite vertex. Hyperplanes containing such an edge use the earlier all-right-vertex theorem. No claim for sections avoiding all42 open edges or for other ambient polytopes.

continuous_argument.sparse_pairings: A PD Coxeter Gram projecting20 orthogonal roots has at most2 nonzero section-normal pairings: opposite signs give an obtuse pair and three equal signs give a non-PD negative triangle.
continuous_argument.projected_line_norm: N=2-(e.r_l)^2/e²; 3/2<N<2 from the PD projected D4 block
continuous_argument.forbidden_actual_ridge: cos²(theta)=1/(2*N), strictly between1/4 and1/3; no Coxeter label
